title: Building a Budapest-inspired arena for my car combat game using Tripo + Astra
author: Dense-Bar-2341
selftext:
I've been working on a new arena for **Brutal Derby**, my solo-developed car combat game. This one is called **Heroes Arena**, inspired by Heroes' Square in Budapest.

I've been working on a new arena for Brutal Derby, my solo-developed car combat game.

This one is called Heroes Arena, inspired by Heroes' Square in Budapest.

The arena needed quite a few custom statues and architectural assets, so I experimented with a different workflow this time. I used Tripo to generate and iterate on several of the 3D assets, then used Astra as part of my development workflow to help integrate and work with them inside the project.

The video shows a quick version of the process, from creating the assets to getting them into Unity and finally seeing them during actual gameplay.

I'm still refining the arena, but I'm pretty happy with how quickly I was able to go from references and ideas to usable assets inside the game.

Everything you see at the end is running in the actual Brutal Derby build.

I'm developing the game solo, so workflows like this can save me a huge amount of time, especially when a level needs a lot of unique environment assets.

Would be interested to hear what you think of the workflow and the arena so far.

And yes, if you like it, you can wishlist on Steam:)

\#BrutalDerby #TripoAI #AIGameDev #Unity3D #IndieGameDev #GameDevelopment #Budapest #WreckFest #DestructionDerby
